Our understanding of the literature is that there is no such thing as safe recreational use of volatile solvents, aerosols and other street inhalants : their psychoactive effects are inseparable from nerve and organ damage. We have chosen to include these reports to help document the real world use of inhalants, but their inclusion is not intended to imply that they are anything but dangerous.]
I got high, came inside, fell down the stairs, landed face-first, and passed out. When I woke up I wondered why I hurt so bad. My lungs were aching, my heart was racing, and my head was pounding. Then I realized, 'OH! I'm not breathing!' So, I gasped for air, and passed out again. I went out several times after that, although I don't know how many or for how long each time. What I do remember is, each time, I wasn't breathing. I had to fight to stay breathing every time.
